blocks.content:
NHRC has powers of a civil court while investigating cases. It can:
• Summon witnesses
• Receive evidence on affidavit
• Requisition public records
• Issue recommendations to governments
NHRC has powers of a civil court while investigating cases.

items: Competitive exams frequently ask about the nature of NHRC's powers: remember it has the powers of a civil court, not a criminal court.
Note that NHRC can issue recommendations to governments, making its findings advisory in nature.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: NHRC holds the powers of a civil court during the investigation of cases.
It is authorized to summon witnesses and collect evidence on affidavit.
It has the authority to requisition public records when needed.
It issues formal recommendations to governments based on its findings.
